column1: # keying-2026-10-09.tsv: completed push CI runs on main joined to merge_group CI runs by head SHA. Measured 2026-10-09 (UTC) from the API.

# Commands: gh api "repos/jikig-ai/soleur/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?event=push&branch=main&per_page=100" ; gh api --paginate "repos/jikig-ai/soleur/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?event=merge_group&per_page=100" (both written to files, joined with jq -s); gh api "repos/jikig-ai/soleur/actions/runs/<mg_run>/jobs?per_page=100&filter=latest" per matched run.

# mg_conclusion is the conclusion of the picked merge_group run for the SHA (a completed success run if one exists, else the first). mg_completed_before_push is yes when the merge_group run updated_at is not later than the push run created_at.
